questions.text: Identify an authoritative product or repository source for this option.
Confirm the exact product release and configuration being evaluated.
Request a current, product- and version-matched Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR).
Confirm the ACR date and the scope of the evaluation.
Vendor-reported support is not independently verified; request supporting test evidence.
Ask which tasks are affected, the impact on users, and the remediation plan.
Document reported barriers, affected tasks, and feasible alternatives; obtain specialist review.
Not evaluated means evidence is missing, not that the option has failed.
The accessibility claim is unknown; obtain structured evidence before comparing accessibility.
Plan independent evaluation of critical user tasks with appropriate assistive technology.
Obtain the evaluation plan, methods, coverage, and completion date.
Locate the actual independent evaluation report; verify its scope, date, and findings.
Determine whether agency Section 508 reviewers must assess any possible exceptions.
